# NPM Global

This mod sets the NPM global folder to /config in code-server/openvscode-server during container start.

Add it to the `code-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-npmglobal
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-npmglobal|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

**This mod requires npm installed via a different mod**

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/code-server-npmglobal/
